# Studiely

> Studiely is an AI-powered study platform for school students. It provides curriculum-aligned summary notes, flashcards, quizzes, exam practice, and Nyla (AI tutor) for IGCSE, GCSE, IB, A-Level, SAT, HSC, and more. Free to start on web, iOS, and Android.

## About

- Brand: Studiely
- Website: https://studiely.com
- App: https://www.studiely.app
- Company: Skyen Solutions (trade name of Qismat Ventures W.L.L.), Bahrain
- Sister platforms: Make My Lesson (https://makemylesson.ai), Linguatude (https://linguatude.com)
- Support: support@studiely.com

Studiely is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or an official product of Cambridge Assessment International Education, Pearson Edexcel, AQA, OCR, the IB Organisation, or any other examination board.

## Exams & Curricula

Supported curriculum systems:
- British: IGCSE, GCSE, A-Level
- International Baccalaureate (IB): PYP, MYP, Diploma Programme
- US: AP courses, Common Core-aligned content
- Canadian: province-aligned content (Grade 1–12)
- Australian: NAPLAN, HSC, VCE, QCE, WACE, SACE, TCE, ACT SSC, NTCET, ATAR

Exam boards referenced (content aligned, not officially affiliated):
- Cambridge Assessment International Education
- Pearson Edexcel
- AQA
- OCR
- IB Organisation
